issues.title: Duplicate custom colors can produce an exporter-ambiguous config.palette
issues.resolution: matchToCBSafe() now runs on the UNIQUE primary hexes; the CB-safe pool is built through a hex->cbSafe lookup so a repeated primary hex always maps to the same CB-safe color, keeping cbSafeColors consistent with the hex-keyed schemeSymbols map. Unit test added: a custom palette with a duplicated hex gets one CB-safe mapping per unique hex and one scheme symbol per unique hex.

issues.title: Saved CB-safe custom palettes do not round-trip correctly
issues.resolution: The custom fallback now recovers family from the saved data: when cbSafeColors is identity-equal to colors per pitch class (the LY spec 4.5 CB-safe-as-primary encoding), family is restored as 'cbsafe', so re-editing keeps the identity branch. Unit test added: a CB-safe custom palette round-trips with family 'cbsafe' and rebuilds with the identity branch intact; a standard custom palette still recovers as 'standard'.

issues.title: Work touched docs/session-sets/ despite 'Touches: none outside cnb/'
issues.resolution: Adjudicated not-a-defect: the spec's 'Touches' line scopes the code/deliverable surface. The session-set directory writes (session-state.json, session-events.jsonl, activity-log.json, s2-uat.md) are the Dabbler orchestration lifecycle the same spec mandates: tier 'full' requires start_session/close_session state flips, the close gate requires activity-log entries and the progress keys the spec itself defines (session-002/*), and requiresUAT/uatScope per-session requires the UAT record in the set directory. Session 1 of this set wrote the identical file kinds and was VERIFIED.
